definition: delayed_recognition_consensus AND top 25% within-stratum held-out future citation uptake
interpretation: A top-25% future-uptake floor is materially more discriminating than the previous top-50% floor.
Positive counts shrink in several medicine and physics strata, showing that some delayed-recognition-consensus cases have only moderate later uptake.
Partial Beauty Coefficient has the highest macro NDCG under this stricter label in this exploratory sample, but performance remains highly stratum-dependent.
The uptake floor is an outcome sensitivity analysis and never enters prospective features.
claim_boundary: Exploratory offline sensitivity using frozen cohort artifacts; not a universal Sleeping Beauty definition.
